apparent_temperature.limitations: Not stored in the bundled baseline ward record.

estimated_surface_temperature.definition: Precomputed demo surface-temperature-like value; the original physical meaning is not independently verified.
estimated_surface_temperature.calculation_method: Unknown; stored as a bundled baseline field.
estimated_surface_temperature.limitations: Not satellite-observed LST; original source, processing method, acquisition time, and validation are unavailable.

hvi.calculation_method: Precomputed demo value; original calculation not verified.
hvi.limitations: A composite project indicator, not a physical measurement or validated health outcome. Do not infer that the stored value was produced by the current live-ingestion formula.

ndvi.definition: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index, commonly calculated from near-infrared and red reflectance.
ndvi.calculation_method: Stored numeric value; no satellite image processing is performed by this application.
ndvi.formula: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) when source reflectance data are available.
ndvi.limitations: No source scene, acquisition date, pixel mask, or processing evidence is bundled; the value is not a verified current satellite calculation.

ndbi.definition: Normalized Difference Built-up Index, commonly calculated from short-wave infrared and near-infrared reflectance.
ndbi.calculation_method: Stored numeric value; no satellite image processing is performed by this application.
ndbi.formula: (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) when source reflectance data are available.
ndbi.limitations: No source scene, acquisition date, pixel mask, or processing evidence is bundled; the value is not a verified current satellite calculation.

population_density.definition: Population-related ward field; original definition and unit have not been verified.
population_density.calculation_method: Read from the bundled JSON; no conversion is performed.
population_density.limitations: Do not describe this as people/km² unless the dataset source confirms the unit.

cluster_assignment.calculation_method: Stored value; current backend rule-based summary is a separate exploratory output.
cluster_assignment.limitations: Not evidence of a trained K-Means model or validated climate classification.
